description: Vermont motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Vermont?
questions.explanation: Vermont helmet law: all riders and passengers.

questions.q: What does Vermont law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: Vermont: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

provenance.manual: 23 V.S.A. § 1115. Operating motorcycles and motor-driven cycles on roadways laned for traffic

questions.q: What does Vermont require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: Vermont: eye protection is required unless the motorcycle has a windshield.
